title: Heavenly Sunlight
description: Heavenly Sunlight in Tonic Solfa to SUNLIGHT: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Henry J. Zelley wrote the words, published in 1899 with the tune SUNLIGHT by G. H. Cook.
underlay: Walk-ing in sun-light all of my jour-ney, O-ver the moun-tains, through the deep vale; Je-sus has said, I’ll nev-er for-sake thee— Pro-mise di-vine that nev-er can fail. Heav-en-ly sun-light! Heav-en-ly sun-light! Flood-ing my soul with glo-ry di-vine_; Hal-le-lu-jah! I am re-joic-ing_, Sing-ing His prais-es, Je-sus is mine!

lines: Walking in sunlight all of my journey,
Over the mountains, through the deep vale;
Jesus has said, I’ll never forsake thee—
Promise divine that never can fail.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Flooding my soul with glory divine;
Singing His praises, Jesus is mine!
Shadows around me, shadows above me
Never conceal my Saviour and Guide;
He is the light, in Him is no darkness,
Ever I’m walking close to His side.
In the bright sunlight, ever rejoicing,
Pressing my way to mansions above;
Singing His praises, gladly I’m walking,
Walking in sunlight, sunlight of love.
